deviations.baseline_behavior: Providers receive a mutable Context set by the engine and have no policy mediation layer.
deviations.proposed_behavior: A mandatory policy mediation layer between engine and providers and an explicit per-call context object.
deviations.benefit: Root confinement, rights and audit enforced outside provider code.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Provider authors must target a new context type.

deviations.baseline_behavior: File-system drives are auto-mounted on lookup miss.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Mount drives explicitly or from configuration.
deviations.benefit: Predictable drive table; no hidden system probing.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Scripts using unmounted drive letters need explicit mounts.
